property_summary: After any successful transferFrom of a minted position, ownership moves: c.ownerOf(id) equals the recipient; the mutant never updates _ownerOf so the original owner still shows as owner for some inputs.
After any successful transferFrom of a Putty position NFT, the new recipient must own the token (c.ownerOf(id) == to); the mutant leaves _ownerOf unchanged so the previous owner still owns it.

After a successful transferFrom of a minted position NFT, the original owner irrevocably loses ownership, so any subsequent transferFrom attempt by the original owner must revert (WRONG_FROM); the mutant keeps _ownerOf at the old owner, so the second transfer succeeds.
m_diagnostic: testFuzz_property(address,address,uint256,uint256,uint256): original owner must not be able to transfer an already-transferred token

property_summary: For any filled order, the taker's newly minted position NFT must be owned by the caller (ownerOf(positionId) == msg.sender); the mutant never records _ownerOf in _mint, so ownerOf reverts ('NOT_MINTED') after a fill.

For any authorized transferFrom of a token id, the sender's and recipient's balances must change in a matched way so that both accounts' balanceOf readings remain consistent (in C all balances stay constant at type(uint256).max); the mutant drops the sender's decrement, breaking the sender/recipient balance correspondence for some input.
